description: This file defines the LocationService class which manages location updates using CoreLocation. It handles authorization, location requests, streaming updates, and significant location change monitoring, encapsulating CLLocationManager interactions.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: A final class managing location updates, authorization, and significant location change monitoring via CLLocationManager.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Asynchronously ensures the app has the required location authorization based on mode (when-in-use or always).

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the current location asynchronously, respecting desired accuracy, max age, and timeout parameters.

methods.name: startLocationUpdates
methods.description: Starts streaming location updates with specified accuracy and monitoring mode, returning an async stream of CLLocation objects.

methods.name: startMonitoringSignificantLocationChanges
methods.description: Begins monitoring for significant location changes with a callback invoked on updates.
